title: Blog: 5 Best Practices to Save Energy With Your ATM Fleet
summary: Financial Institutions face challenges in reducing energy consumption and carbon footprint. This blog explores five best practices for a more sustainable and efficient ATM fleet.
body_markdown:
**Energy savings is a key issue for banks**


The global trend to reduce energy consumption is driven by the urgent need to address climate change. Financial Institutions (FIs) face several challenges when it comes to reducing their energy consumption. They have complex operations and infrastructure which makes reducing their energy consumption while maintaining their operations at high-level quality a challenge. Security and reliability as well as the adoption of new technologies are often time-consuming and costly. These are additional challenges to overcome.


Some FIs have taken steps to reduce their own energy consumption and carbon footprint. They install energy management systems in their buildings, invest in renewable energy, or encourage their employees to adopt eco-friendly practices. Another area where energy-efficient policies can have an important impact is the self-service channel.


**5 best practices to save energy with your ATM fleet**


By implementing these measures, banks can significantly reduce the energy consumption associated with their ATMs. This reduces their cost of ownership and assures consumers that they are also contributed to limit their impact on the environment.
